requirements.description: In stream_to_mem.sv, deassert req_ready_o, mem_req_valid_o, and resp_valid_o on flush_i, flush i_resp_buf, discard stale in-flight responses returning on or after flush_i, and reclaim cnt_q credits.
In cv32e40p_obi_interface.sv (TRANS_STABLE=0), hold obi_addr_o, obi_we_o, obi_be_o, obi_wdata_o, and obi_atop_o stable in REGISTERED state and forward obi_err_i on resp_err_o.

In constraints.json, constrain pmp_in->pmp_out to 1.25 ns internal max delay (8.75 ns with 4.0 ns in + 3.5 ns out) and dbg_in->dbg_out to 2.25 ns internal max delay (9.75 ns with 4.0 ns in + 3.5 ns out) without modifying registered stream/OBI ports.
requirements.verified_by: private/grader/run.py timing stage across 10 ns and 12 ns clocks
